text:
Maria: heads-up — CI docs build failed after merging #4892, sidebar collapsed and linkcheck flagged a bunch of broken links :grimacing:
Ben: ugh. is this mkdocs or docusaurus site? which build job failed?
Maria: docusaurus v2 site (docs.redwood.internal). build job `docs:build` in CI. runs fine locally for me until I run linkcheck.
Sam: I reproduced — when an MDX file has an empty frontmatter title it ends up with an empty slug and the sidebar/nav ordering gets messed up. Linkcheck then reports 404s because some generated TOC entries point to `/` or duplicate indexes.
Ben: can you paste a minimal repro?
Maria: sure:
```
---
title: ""
sidebar_label: ""
---

# content
```
Sam: yep. docusaurus slugify treats empty title as `""` -> `""` and then normalizer collapses it into the root index slot. Sidebar tree ends up with multiple entries linking to same path.
docs-bot: linkcheck: 26 broken fragments found in docs build (job 9823). Affected paths listed in artifact `linkcheck-report.json`.
June: quick mitigation: we can add a validator in the docs CI step that fails if frontmatter `title` or `sidebar_label` is blank. I'll open a tiny PR on the docs repo to scan `*.mdx` for `^title:\s*""` and `sidebar_label` blanks and emit a non-blocking warning first, then block on next patch.
Ben: also suggests a small transform in our docusaurus plugin to fallback to filename if title is empty. less disruption for content authors.
Sam: agree. I'll draft the plugin patch (fallback to nearest file basename, and ensure unique slug by appending `-n` if collision). Will include unit tests.
Maria: for the immediate incident, can we hotfix the site? We need redirects for the broken links and a rollback of #4892 if it's risky.
June: I reverted the merge locally and rebuilt — that removes the collapse. I'll push PR #4901 to revert until we land the validation + plugin fix.
Maria: thanks. @Sam @Ben can you coordinate on the plugin + CI PRs? I'll post a short note in the release channel and update the incident ticket with the revert and follow-ups.
Ben: will add CI job `docs:frontmatter-check` and a small GH action that scans frontmatter. linking to internal script at `scripts/docs/frontmatter_check.py` in the PR.
Sam: allocating time today to the plugin. target: PR by end of day, tests included.
Maria: sweet. action items: revert PR merged (done as #4901), add CI frontmatter check (Ben), fallback slug plugin patch (Sam), create redirects for any public broken links (I'll coordinate with infra).
June: I'll monitor linkcheck runs and re-run after each patch. ping me if you want me to merge the revert. :thumbsup: 
Maria: thanks everyone — let's aim to have a non-breaking rollout with tests so this doesn't recur.
